name: Text-to-Video Person Re-ID Benchmark
description: A dataset and benchmark for text-to-video person re-identification that evaluates dual-modal contextual alignment between text descriptions and video.
reputation: A recent domain-specific benchmark (2025) attracting interest in multimodal retrieval and person re-identification communities but not yet widely adopted.
notes: Non-LLM / vision+text benchmark; potential dataset biases and annotation noise; moderate dataset size and domain-specific (person re-id) evaluation may limit generalization; standard contamination concerns for person-identification datasets (privacy/bias).
